en: A vintage, monochrome postcard showing a panoramic view over a spa town nestled in a green valley. Numerous grand 19th‑century style buildings line tree‑filled streets, with large bath or spa complexes in the foreground and gently rolling hills in the background. German captions are printed at the top and bottom, and there is a red handwritten number in the upper right corner.
